summary: TNL Mediagene filed a Form 6-K on September 3, 2026, announcing a 1-for-8 share consolidation effective September 8, 2026. Shareholders approved up to a 1-for-10 ratio at an EGM on August 25, 2026; the board set 1-for-8 on August 27. Outstanding shares will drop from 6,084,581 to approximately 760,573. Fractional shares round up. The reverse split aims to regain Nasdaq's $1 minimum bid price compliance. Warrants and equity awards adjust proportionally. This is a corporate action to maintain listing, not a special situation; watch trading and compliance progress.
